decided: The brief's new-terms section shows each distinct definition of a term once, naming the records that wrote it; a term two records define differently appears twice, each definition beside its records.
alternatives: show one definition per term, the most recent one
show each record's terms beside that record, with no section of their own
why: A term's definition belongs to the record that used it, so keeping only the most recent could give an older decision a meaning its author did not intend, and the charter names new terms as a section of its own. The user chose this at the proposal review.
